question: To promote Indian Culture and Art, President Draupadi Murmu conferred which of the following awards in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**70th National Film Awards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Film Awards is one of the most prominent film award ceremonies in India, established in 1954.
 
• The awards aim to encourage the production of films of high aesthetic and technical standards and educational and cultural value.
 
• The 70th National Film Awards recognize the best of Indian cinema released in the year 2022.
 
• President Draupadi Murmu conferred these awards in October 2024, honoring outstanding contributions in various categories including Best Feature Film, Best Actor, Best Actress, and others.
 
• These awards are presented by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directorate of Film Festivals (DFF)**

 
 
• It was established by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India, to organize national and international film festivals within the country.
 
• DFF administers the National Film Awards and the International Film Festival of India (IFFI).
 
• It aims to promote good cinema and facilitate the exchange of ideas and experiences between Indian and foreign filmmakers.
 
 
 
• **Categories of National Film Awards**
 
 
• These awards include Feature Films, Non-Feature Films, and Best Writing on Cinema.
 
• Feature Film awards comprise several categories such as Best Feature Film, Best Direction, Best Actor, Best Actress, etc.
 
• Non-Feature Film awards include Best Non-Feature Film, Best Director, and various technical awards.
 
 
 
• **Significance of National Film Awards**
 
 
• They are considered the most prestigious awards in the Indian film industry, often referred to as India's equivalent to the Oscars.
 
• These awards help in recognizing and encouraging new talent and excellence in Indian cinema.
 
• The awards also highlight the diversity of Indian cinema, covering films produced in different languages and regions.
 
 
 
• **Recent Trends in National Film Awards**
 
 
• In recent years, there has been a notable increase in the number of regional films being recognized.
 
• There is also a growing emphasis on films with strong social messages and innovative storytelling.
 
• Digital and independent filmmakers are increasingly gaining recognition at these awards.
